content:
We're getting a sneak peek at the Amazon Prime Big Deal Days — AirPods Pro 3 just dropped to $179 with free shipping, marking one of the lowest prices we've ever seen.

Although the Prime Big Deal Days event doesn't officially start for roughly 48 more hours, Amazon has jumped the gun and is now offering Apple's flagship AirPods Pro 3 for $179 with free shipping.

  • AirPods Pro 3 for $179 (originally $249) — one of the best prices ever

Currently, the latest-generation Pros are priced at $249, and although we've seen them drop to $199 on multiple occasions over the summer, this deal knocks a further $70 off the price tag, which is a substantial discount.

Apple recently released the all-new AirPods 5 in two versions: the base model with ANC active noise cancellation for $129, and an upgraded version with a wireless charging case. In my view, Apple's new release with ANC at just $129 is excellent value for money, but if you want the model with a wireless charging case, that'll cost you $149. For just $30 more, though, you can now get the much more capable AirPods Pro 3.

The Pro 3 boasts 3x better active noise cancellation, longer battery life, and more advanced health features such as a built-in heart rate sensor and hearing aid functionality. For more details, be sure to check out our earlier head-to-head feature — AirPods Pro 3 vs AirPods 5.

The AirPods 5 at $129 for the base model is certainly a solid choice, but the more capable AirPods Pro 3 at just $179 is a very tempting discount — and one we've only seen once before today.

This price drop comes just weeks after Apple rolled out a host of new features for the AirPods Pro 3 alongside iOS 27. That update finally introduced the long-awaited custom EQ feature:

Other new additions include new ways to control Adaptive Audio, improved Find My integration, and more.
